name: RequestOrbit
shortDescription: Create your own URL redirects. Choose the scope, test the result, and keep rules local.
detailedDescription:
Make links go where you want. Enter an original URL and a destination to create a redirect—no regular expressions needed.

• Choose one URL, one path, or an entire host. Test before saving.
• Block requests, upgrade HTTP to HTTPS, and edit request headers.
• Back up your rules and preview imports before applying them.

Rules stay on your device. No account, ads, or analytics. Site access is requested only when a rule needs it. Available in English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, and Spanish.
privacySummary: RequestOrbit does not collect, transmit, sell, or share personal data. Rules, preferences, and recovery snapshots stay in browser extension storage on this device.
permissionSummary: Installation requests no website access. Storage keeps rules locally, declarativeNetRequest lets the browser enforce user-authored rules, and activeTab identifies the current site only after the user opens the popup. Optional host access is requested at enable time for only the concrete request and initiator origins a redirect or header rule requires.
chromeLegacyMigrationNote: Previously My Webrequest. Chrome users can review and export their legacy rules before migration. Converted rules start disabled; unsupported features are explained.
screenshotCaptions: Manage rules, runtime status, browser quotas, and precise match conditions in one focused workspace.
Review the exact website origins a rule needs before continuing to the browser permission prompt.
Verify backup integrity and preview safe merge or replacement effects before changing any rule.
